The boy with a pencil

I was once a boy who picked up a pencil, filled with a deep longing to write. But the stories I penned in worn notebooks dissolved into the winds of hardship, drifting away as quiet disappointments.

Becoming an engineer

Believing I would never write again, I became an engineer. Yet, little did I know I was still moving within a greater, divine design.

Finding the purpose

It was only when numbers and letters took electronic form that I realized the truth: everything I had learned and gained was always meant to serve my Language. In this new dimension, I weave my books as digital threads—crafting a digital saree for my Mother, the sovereign spirit of Tamil.
